overview: This specification defines the architecture and requirements for a scalable data processing pipeline that can handle both batch and real-time data streams.

functional.data_ingestion: Support multiple data sources including databases, APIs, and file systems
functional.data_transformation: Apply configurable transformation rules to incoming data
functional.data_validation: Validate data against predefined schemas and business rules
functional.error_handling: Implement robust error handling and retry mechanisms

non_functional.scalability: Handle up to 1M records per hour during peak loads
non_functional.security: Encrypt data in transit and at rest, implement access controls
non_functional.monitoring: Provide comprehensive logging and metrics for system health

implementation_phases: Phase 1: Core ingestion and basic transformations
Phase 2: Advanced validation and error handling
